Subject: DPA / audit evidence request and e-signature process

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedSync is keen to move forward but procurement needs to lock down the privacy terms before we can issue a PO. A couple of items to confirm:

- Audit rights: We require audit rights that allow our security team to obtain SOC 2 reports and a recent penetration test summary. We are fine with redacted findings but need sufficient detail to validate controls.
- Subprocessors: Please share a current subprocessors list and confirm whether any subprocessors process data outside the US.
- Data transfer: Clarify whether Redwood relies on standard contractual clauses / SCCs for cross-border transfers and whether customers can request data residency restrictions.
- Execution: Does Redwood accept DocuSign? If so, what is the typical turnaround to sign a standard DPA?

Can you send a redline or guidance by EOD Wednesday? Procurement is on a tight schedule.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
MedSync Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list, and glad MedSync is ready to move. Quick answers up front: Redwood accepts DocuSign, we can provide a SOC 2 report (redacted) and a high-level pen test summary. We maintain a subprocessors list and can confirm locations.

I attached a preliminary DPA redline for your review (high level redlines only — legal will chime in with the rationale for a couple of clauses). Key notes:
- SOC 2 + redacted pen test summary as primary evidence (we propose delivery within 10 business days of execution).
- Subprocessor list attached separately; we can confirm any non-US subprocessors and support contractual controls.
- For on-site audits, we typically offer a limited scope review by exception (requires 60 days notice and a scoped SOW).

Next steps: 1) Laura will follow up on audit-scope language; 2) If you can send PO details, I can attach to the DocuSign envelope when we send the DPA; 3) If redlines are acceptable, we’ll route for execution via DocuSign.

Alex — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying questions from our security team:

2) Subprocessors: Please indicate which subprocessors access unredacted customer data and whether any are located in APAC.
3) Pen test summary: We understand redaction but need at least a findings summary and remediation status for critical/high items.

Thanks,

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsync.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA / audit evidence request and e-signature process

Elena — hi, Laura here (Redwood Legal). I'm following up with the legal/controls perspective and to propose final language so we can get to signature. Summary of our position and proposed edits:

- Evidence: Redwood will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary) and a high-level penetration test overview that lists the test scope, number of findings by severity, and remediation status for critical/high items. We cannot provide raw exploit details or customer-identifiable test artifacts.
- Audit rights: We will accept a mechanism where customers may request a third-party attestation and provide on-site or remote evidence with 60 days' notice. The clause will specify that audits are limited to scope of Redwood-managed controls relevant to the customer's data and that any audit that necessitates additional vendor or third-party engagement will be scoped and charged.
- Subprocessors: Attached is our current subprocessor roster (CSV). We have one contractor regionally in APAC that handles monitoring telemetry (no access to content data). Any subprocessor that processes content data is listed as US-based.
- Cross-border transfers: We rely on SCCs and other lawful transfer mechanisms; customers may request contractual commitments for residency where supported by our deployment options (Dedicated / Private).

If those edits are acceptable, we'll finalize the DPA and prepare a DocuSign envelope. Proposed timeline: finalize language by Thu 7/23, envelope live Fri 7/24, signed by early next week.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
